descripcion:
QF Flota es la app de QF Producciones para llevar los vehículos y la unidad móvil de transmisión desde el iPhone.

• Registra la gasolina en segundos: valor, galones, tanque lleno y gasolinera (con el GPS te sugiere la más cercana).
• Gastos y servicios: lavado, peajes, parqueo, cambio de aceite, llantas, taller…
• Kilometraje del tablero y aviso del próximo mantenimiento.
• Viajes por etapas, con combustible, peajes y viáticos de cada tramo.
• Foto del recibo con la cámara.
• Informes: costo por km, rendimiento, comparación con el mes o año anterior, por conductor y por gasolinera, y Excel para compartir.
• Sin señal no se pierde nada: lo escrito queda guardado en el teléfono hasta que vuelva el internet.

HECHA PARA EL IPHONE
Atajos en el ícono (Registrar gasolina, Informes, Agenda de mantenimiento), hoja de Compartir para los Excel y PDF, y pantalla propia sin conexión.

Es una herramienta de trabajo: solo pueden entrar las personas a las que la empresa les creó un usuario, por ejemplo los choferes.

Hecho en Ecuador por QF Producciones y Tukán Software.
texto_promocional: Registra la gasolina en segundos y mira el costo por km, el rendimiento y los informes de cada vehículo de QF Producciones.
notas_revisor:
1. Screen recording (physical iPhone, latest iOS): {video}

2. Purpose and audience: QF Flota is the fleet-control app of QF Producciones, an event and live-broadcast production company in Ecuador (same group as Tukán Software). It is for the company's drivers and administrators: they record fuel, expenses, services, mileage and trips of the company vehicles and the broadcast mobile unit, and the app calculates cost per km and maintenance reminders. Problem it solves: replaces paper logs and receipts for the company's vehicles.

3. How to use it: sign in with the demo account in the App Review Information section (a driver/administrator user of a sample company with invented data). After login, Flota opens with the vehicle list; open a vehicle for its history and costs. The menu and tabs include: Registrar gasolina (value, gallons, full tank, gas station, receipt photo), Gastos y servicios (wash, tolls, parking, oil change, tires, workshop), Kilometraje, Viajes (by stages with fuel, tolls and per diem), Informes (cost per km, fuel economy, comparison with previous month or year, Excel/PDF to share), Agenda (which vehicle goes to which event), Revisión antes de salir, Fallas y taller, Llantas, Garantías and Más (settings and Telegram reminders). Drivers see only their own functions. Accounts are created by QF Producciones for its drivers and administrators; there is no self sign-up in the iOS app, and account deletion is handled on request (info@tukansoftware.com). On iPhone there are no prices, plans or payments for our software: it is an internal tool, not sold through the app.

4. External services: the company's own server (erp.tupassec.com); Telegram notifications for maintenance and document-expiry reminders (optional); email (SMTP); Cloudflare (hosting/CDN); OpenStreetMap to suggest the nearest gas station (only when the user asks, with the position rounded). Camera: only to photograph a receipt, gas station or vehicle when the user taps the photo button. Location: only when the user taps the GPS button while recording fuel or a trip; no background tracking. No ads, no third-party analytics.

5. Regional differences: none. The app works the same in every region (Spanish).

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not regulated. Access is only for people the company created a user for. Not affiliated with Drivvo. Privacy policy: https://erp.tupassec.com/privacidad.php.
